database.persistence_scope: saved disposable database copy reopened and verified in a separate IDALIB process

notes: The five native callbacks without saved IDA boundaries were created from exact ELF .eh_frame FDE ranges.
Two script-table FDE starts were inside larger saved IDA functions. The boundary pass split those ranges before adding the callback functions.
IDALIB closed and repacked the translated copy, and a separate read-only verifier reopened it with all 1,211 expected names intact.
The original IDA database was not overwritten because its active unpacked state remained locked by the desktop session.
